evidence_digest: Validated the repair contract and required provider-delivery context. Doctor calls contentHash without importing it, causing a caught ReferenceError and false drift/error diagnostics. Package tests pass command-name npm_execpath to Node as though it were a JavaScript path. Init still expects five total entries instead of five base entries plus PROVIDER_SOURCE_ALLOWLIST.length. The forged-manifest removal test incorrectly expects clean initialization to reject before a manifest exists. Risks: preserve fail-closed attribution/hash/path checks and shell=false package invocation. Verification: run the contract focused provider suite, pnpm build, and pnpm pack:check.
